title: Counterexample to the characteristic-imset sink-edge conjecture
scope: Refutation of arXiv2302.03647v2 Conjecture1: there is a five-vertex skeleton G, an acyclic orientation C and vertex4 whose sink orientation D is not Markov equivalent to C, while the segment between their characteristic imsets is not an edge (indeed not a face) of the convex hull of characteristic imsets of ALL acyclic orientations of G. All26 subset coordinates, genuine d-separation, actual sink operation and real convex-face bridge included. No general diameter-bound refutation or minimality claim.
